verdict.rationale: Kino AI is a desktop video-editing product that runs an MCP server and has agent integrations, so release notes or a changelog for its skills and updates is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions release notes, a changelog, versioning, or update notes. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
